executiveSummary: The reporting period highlights intensified election-related threats in the United States, with federal authorities warning that actors are deploying convincing deepfake audio and video alongside AI-enabled phishing against election and campaign officials Source . Concurrently, a complementary FBI fraud advisory warns of AI-generated impersonation content used to solicit donations and personal data from voters and donors Source . Multiple high-impact impersonation frauds underscore enterprise and financial-sector exposure, including a reported multimillion-dollar deepfake video-call scam in Hong Kong and a large voice-clone executive impersonation loss in Italy View Article . Law-enforcement impersonation also escalated, with cloned sheriff voices used in Florida to coerce residents Source . Information operations persisted at scale: OpenAI reported disrupting Russian and Iranian false-front influence operations using AI-generated personas and materials Supporting Report . U.S. and European elections saw AI-manipulated political videos and warnings from state authorities View Article View Article . Consumer and voter risk indicators also rose, with media analysis noting increased deepfake-related fraud attempts View Article . On defense, providers advanced provenance and anti-scam capabilities, including OpenAI's content-provenance verification guidance Vendor Advisory , Android's AI scam protections View Article , and Microsoft Teams' phishing and impersonation safeguards View Article . Overall, the threat environment appears to be worsening given concurrent election manipulation, public-safety impersonation, and high-value enterprise frauds.

Election operations: Implement multi-channel verification for urgent requests; require secondary approval for credential or configuration changes. (Analyst Recommendation)
Financial controls: Enforce out-of-band callbacks to pre-registered numbers for any payment instruction changes; prohibit voice-only approvals. (Analyst Recommendation)
Provenance: Integrate C2PA/SynthID checks where supported; treat absence of signals as "unknown," not authentic. (Analyst Recommendation)
Collaboration platforms: Enable impersonation and phishing warnings; restrict external meeting lobby bypass; log and review high-risk sessions. (Analyst Recommendation)
Public communications: Publish official contact protocols to help citizens distinguish legitimate outreach from scams. (Analyst Recommendation)
